header.phase1: First half: play for the face-up card
header.upCardNone: No face-up card (stock exhausted; trump is {{suit}})
header.firstHalfNote: Tricks in this half do not score

hint.germanWhistTakeUpCard: The face-up card is worth having — win this trick.
hint.germanWhistDuck: The face-up card isn't worth having. Throw a cheap card and lose on purpose.
hint.germanWhistWinTrick: Tricks score now, so take this one.

tutorial.upCard: The card turned face up. The first half's tricks are played for this one card, and the suit of the very first face-up card is trump for the whole hand.
tutorial.trick: Cards played this trick appear here. If you hold the led suit you must follow it.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards carry a green ring. In the first half the real decision is whether to win the trick or duck it.
tutorial.actions: Reset deals again and Give up ends the game. The hint's aim changes between the halves.
